title: Bulk change that partly fails lists the failed part and its reason
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PARTFAIL-01) is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PARTFAIL-02) is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
  • {Part-A} and {Part-B} share the start of their numbers (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PARTFAIL-0), so one search lists them together.
  • A second browser tab is open on Parts → Inventory at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab, on the Active tab, search the start that {Part-A} and {Part-B} share (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PARTFAIL-0).
  2. Open the ⋮ actions menu and click "Deactivate parts".
  3. Tick {Part-A} and {Part-B}.
  4. In the second tab open {Part-B}, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save and click "Deactivate".
  5. In the first tab click "Deactivate" in the bulk bar, then "Deactivate" in the confirmation.
  6. Read the message at the bottom right.
  7. Wait 10 seconds. Do not close the message.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: {Part-A} leaves the Active tab; the bulk mode stays on with only {Part-B} ticked (2 ticked = 1 changed + 1 failed).
  • Step 6: An error message reads "1 part updated, 1 could not be changed." and lists {Part-B} by its part number with the reason "Part is already in that state."
  • Step 7: The message is still there after 10 seconds (it stays until closed).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R12, S10-R12a, S10-R13, S10-R13a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: board 4.5 shows only the all-changed result. Engineering's 8 Oct comment and Product's reply (singular "1 part updated"). SV-11040 verification checklist. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R12: “After a bulk change, the system shows how many parts changed and how many failed.”
  • S10-R12a: “The counts include only the parts the user selected. A core that changes with its part is not counted, so changing 2 parts that both have a core reads "2 parts updated."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, some parts failed): “"{n} parts updated, {m} could not be changed." ("1 part updated, {m} could not be changed." for one) | Error toast, stays until closed, lists each failed part and its reason”
  • S10-R13: “For each part that failed, the system names the part by its number and gives the reason.”
  • S10-R13a: “The reasons are "A core follows its part. Activate or deactivate the part instead.", "Part not found." and "Part is already in that state."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (A part already in the requested state): “"Part is already in that state." | Listed as the failure reason”
  • SV-11040 verification checklist: “Partial failure (one part changed in another tab first) → "1 part updated, 1 could not be changed." listing the reason; only the failed part stays ticked (S2-R15, S10-N2)”
